purpose: An optional, passive, installed exact-build callback reports sanitized known missing-capability states to the existing adapter. It never grants native game execution, adjusts player control, or claims an installed hook is active.

files.reason: An optional wrapper around already registered cycle callback emits bounded advisory classification after the unchanged native cycle result; no game or OS action is added.
Pure deterministic in-memory status classification with no game observation, disk or effect; only a properly bound native observer can connect this output to evidence.

successor_gate: Native exact build port registration and play receipt reconciliation under issue #171; no retroactive port activation.
